body.ru:
• результат важен сейчас
• опыт за всю жизнь
• незаконченный период (today, this week)
• **first time / the first time**
• действие длится до сих пор (for/since)
body.en:
• the result matters now
• experience in a lifetime
• an unfinished period (today, this week)
• **first time / the first time**
• an action continuing up to now (for/since)

examples: I have read two books this week.
This is the first time I have flown.
exampleTranslations: На этой неделе я прочитал две книги.

questions.sentence: I ___ already finished my homework.

explanation.ru: С подлежащим I в Present Perfect используется have + причастие finished.
explanation.en: With the subject I, Present Perfect uses have + the participle finished.

questions.sentence: She ___ lived here since 2019.

explanation.ru: Подлежащее she требует has; since 2019 — точка отсчёта.
explanation.en: The subject she requires has; since 2019 marks the starting point.

questions.sentence: They ___ never been to London.

translation.ru: Они никогда не были в Лондоне.

explanation.ru: Опыт с never: have + been; подлежащее they требует have.
explanation.en: Experience with never: have + been; the subject they requires have.

questions.sentence: ___ you ever eaten sushi?

explanation.ru: Вопрос об опыте: Have + подлежащее you + ever + причастие eaten.
explanation.en: A question about experience: Have + the subject you + ever + the participle eaten.

questions.sentence: He ___ just left the office.

translation.ru: Он только что вышел из офиса.

explanation.ru: Just и подлежащее he требуют has + причастие left.
explanation.en: Just and the subject he require has + the participle left.

questions.sentence: We ___ not seen that film yet.

translation.ru: Мы ещё не видели тот фильм.

explanation.ru: Отрицание с we: have not + причастие seen; yet ставится в конце.
explanation.en: The negative with we: have not + the participle seen; yet comes at the end.

questions.sentence: I have ___ my keys, so I cannot open the door.

translation.ru: Я потерял ключи, поэтому не могу открыть дверь.

explanation.ru: После have нужно причастие прошедшего времени: lose → lost.
explanation.en: After have the past participle is needed: lose → lost.

questions.sentence: She has ___ in many countries.

explanation.ru: После has нужна форма причастия: regular verb travel → travelled.
explanation.en: After has the participle form is needed: the regular verb travel → travelled.

questions.sentence: He has not finished his homework ___.

translation.ru: Он ещё не закончил домашнее задание.

explanation.ru: Yet ставится в конце отрицательного предложения в Present Perfect.
explanation.en: Yet goes at the end of a negative Present Perfect sentence.

questions.sentence: He has ___ arrived, so we can start.

translation.ru: Он только что приехал, так что можем начинать.

explanation.ru: Just — «только что» — ставится между have/has и причастием.
explanation.en: Just means a very short time ago and goes between have/has and the participle.

questions.sentence: I have lived here ___ five years.

explanation.ru: For + длительность (five years) с Present Perfect.
explanation.en: For + a length of time (five years) with Present Perfect.

questions.sentence: She has worked here ___ 2020.

explanation.ru: Since + точка отсчёта (2020) с Present Perfect.
explanation.en: Since + a starting point (2020) with Present Perfect.

questions.sentence: I have not seen him ___ Monday.

translation.ru: Я не видел его с понедельника.

explanation.ru: Since + конкретный день (Monday), от которого ведётся отсчёт.
explanation.en: Since + a particular day (Monday), the point from which we count.

questions.sentence: We have known each other ___ ten years.

translation.ru: Мы знакомы друг с другом десять лет.

explanation.ru: For + длительность (ten years) с Present Perfect.
explanation.en: For + a length of time (ten years) with Present Perfect.

questions.sentence: I have ___ this film three times.

translation.ru: Я смотрел этот фильм три раза.

explanation.ru: После have нужно причастие: see → seen.
explanation.en: After have the participle is needed: see → seen.

questions.sentence: Have you ever ___ to Paris?

explanation.ru: Опыт поездки с возвращением передаёт been: have been to Paris.
explanation.en: Experience of a trip and return is expressed with been: have been to Paris.

questions.sentence: She has ___ to the shops, so she is not at home.

translation.ru: Она ушла в магазин, поэтому её нет дома.

explanation.ru: Gone значит «уехал и ещё там», поэтому её нет дома.
explanation.en: Gone means went and is still away, so she is not at home.

questions.sentence: I ___ my homework yet.

translation.ru: Я ещё не сделал домашнее задание.

explanation.ru: Yet в конце предложения требует Present Perfect: have not finished.
explanation.en: Yet at the end of the sentence requires Present Perfect: have not finished.

questions.sentence: We ___ each other for twenty years, and we are still friends.

translation.ru: Мы знаем друг друга двадцать лет, и мы до сих пор друзья.

explanation.ru: And we are still friends показывает, что период продолжается, поэтому нужен Present Perfect: have known.
explanation.en: And we are still friends shows that the period continues, so the Present Perfect is needed: have known.

questions.sentence: This is the first time I ___ this song.

explanation.ru: После оборота this is the first time используется Present Perfect: have heard.
explanation.en: After this is the first time, Present Perfect is used: have heard.

prompt.en: Match each situation with its example.

left.en: the report is ready — the result matters

pairs.right: She has finished the report.

left.en: they have not arrived up to now

pairs.right: They have not arrived yet.

left.ru: интересуемся опытом: видел ли ты этот фильм
left.en: asking about experience: have you seen this film

pairs.right: Have you seen this film?

left.en: the suitcases are already packed

pairs.right: We have already packed our suitcases.

explanation.ru: Примеры показывают результат к настоящему моменту, отсутствие результата, вопрос об опыте и уже выполненное действие.
explanation.en: The examples show a result by now, a missing result, a question about experience and an action that is already done.

prompt.en: Match each meaning with its example.

left.en: the result matters now

pairs.right: He has broken his glasses, so he cannot read.

left.en: experience in a lifetime

pairs.right: He has travelled to many countries.

left.en: an unfinished period

pairs.right: She has written three emails today.

left.en: an action completed a moment ago

pairs.right: The film has just started.

explanation.ru: Present Perfect связывает прошлое с настоящим: результат, опыт, незаконченный период и только что завершённое действие.
explanation.en: Present Perfect links the past with the present: a result, experience, an unfinished period and a just-finished action.

prompt.en: Match each meaning with its example.

left.en: the action happened a moment ago

pairs.right: The postman has just delivered a parcel.

left.en: it happened earlier than expected

pairs.right: He has already washed the car.

left.ru: до сих пор это не произошло
left.en: it has not happened up to now

pairs.right: The film has not begun yet.

left.ru: вопрос об опыте за всю жизнь
left.en: a question about experience in life

pairs.right: Has she ever worked abroad?

explanation.ru: Just, already, yet и ever подсказывают Present Perfect: действие связано с настоящим моментом.
explanation.en: Just, already, yet and ever point to the present perfect: the action is connected with the present moment.

prompt.en: Match each meaning with its example.

left.en: duration: the friendship has lasted many years

pairs.right: They have been friends for years.

left.en: starting point: September

pairs.right: She has studied English since September.

left.en: he has not started up to now

pairs.right: He has not started his new job yet.

left.en: no change has happened since Monday

pairs.right: Nothing has changed since Monday.

explanation.ru: For называет длительность, since — точку отсчёта; yet показывает, что действие не произошло к настоящему моменту.
explanation.en: For states a duration, since a starting point, and yet shows that something has not happened up to now.

prompt.en: Match each meaning with its example.

left.en: experience: he has visited Africa

pairs.right: He has been to Africa before.

left.ru: они уехали на вокзал и ещё не вернулись
left.en: they went to the station and are still away

pairs.right: They have gone to the station.

left.ru: впервые в жизни она летит самолётом
left.en: for the first time in her life she is flying

pairs.right: This is the first time she has flown.

left.ru: законченное действие в прошлом: мы навещали их
left.en: a finished action in the past: we visited them

pairs.right: We visited them last week.

explanation.ru: Been значит «был и вернулся», gone — «уехал и ещё там»; first time требует Present Perfect, а законченное прошедшее — Past Simple.
explanation.en: Been means went and came back, gone means went and is still away; first time takes the present perfect, while a finished past action takes the past simple.

prompt.en: Match each situation with its example.

left.en: the work is done — here is the result

pairs.right: I have finished the report.

left.en: she has not called so far

pairs.right: She has not called yet.

left.en: asking whether the homework is done

pairs.right: Have you finished your homework?

left.ru: родители переехали, теперь живут в новой квартире
left.en: my parents moved and now live in a new flat

pairs.right: My parents have moved to a new flat.

explanation.ru: Все примеры показывают действие или его отсутствие, важные для настоящего момента.
explanation.en: All the examples show an action or its absence that matters now.

prompt.en: Match each meaning with its example.

left.en: he left a second ago

pairs.right: He has just left.

left.en: the tickets are already booked

pairs.right: They have already booked the tickets.

left.en: the match has not started up to now

pairs.right: The match has not started yet.

left.ru: вопрос об опыте: пробовал ли ты суши
left.en: a question about experience: have you tried sushi

pairs.right: Have you ever tried sushi?

explanation.ru: Маркеры just, already, yet и ever работают вместе с Present Perfect.
explanation.en: The markers just, already, yet and ever work with the present perfect.

prompt.en: Match each meaning with its example.

left.ru: длительность: я живу здесь пять лет
left.en: duration: I have lived here for five years

pairs.right: I have lived here for five years.

left.en: starting point: 2019

pairs.right: She has worked here since 2019.

left.en: duration: we have known them for many years

pairs.right: We have known them for years.

left.en: nothing has changed since Friday

pairs.right: Nothing has changed since Friday.

explanation.ru: For + длительность и since + точка отсчёта называют действие, которое продолжается до сих пор.
explanation.en: For + duration and since + starting point describe an action that continues up to now.

prompt.en: Match each meaning with its example.

left.ru: он потерял кошелёк — результат важен сейчас
left.en: he has lost his wallet — the result matters now

pairs.right: He has lost his wallet.

left.ru: тётя дважды была в Испании — опыт
left.en: my aunt has visited Spain twice — experience

pairs.right: My aunt has visited Spain twice.

left.ru: в этом месяце я прочитал три статьи
left.en: this month I have read three articles

pairs.right: I have read three articles this month.

left.en: they have just arrived

pairs.right: They have just arrived.

explanation.ru: Результат сейчас, опыт, незаконченный период и только что совершённое действие — типичные значения Present Perfect.
explanation.en: A result now, experience, an unfinished period and a just-finished action are typical meanings of the present perfect.

prompt.en: Match each meaning with its example.

left.en: experience: I have visited Italy

pairs.right: I have been to Italy.

left.ru: она ушла в магазины и ещё не вернулась
left.en: she went to the shops and is still away

pairs.right: She has gone to the shops.

left.en: I am meeting him for the first time

pairs.right: This is the first time I have met him.

left.ru: вчера мы смотрели фильм — законченное прошлое
left.en: yesterday we watched a film — a finished past action

pairs.right: We watched a film yesterday.

explanation.ru: Been и gone дают разный результат; first time требует Present Perfect, а yesterday — Past Simple.
explanation.en: Been and gone give different results; first time takes the present perfect, while yesterday takes the past simple.
